subject: ADR-176: the deployment log's field sheet and the soil recipes' shopping list, read -- four exports on two pages held byte for byte
body: TWO PAGES, ONE SHAPE. With every page carrying three or more unread outputs closed (ADR-172 to ADR-175), the worklist is pages with one or two, two a slice from here. The deployment log's task (ADR-152) already held the CSV; the FIELD SHEET -- the thing a technician tapes to the recorder -- and the print were unread. The task presses Copy field sheet in its end state and holds the sheet BYTE FOR BYTE (three deployments in the order logged; the flight's GSD 2.10 cm/px at 120 m; the logger every 1 min for 90 d; the recorder at 48 kHz mono with Nyquist 24.0 kHz and its caveats), then the print, one payload; 174 -> 183 confirmed. verify_dep pins the literal's arithmetic from its own ports -- the GSD from the sensor the task typed over the RedEdge preset (6.17 mm, 8.8 mm focal, 4000 px; the sheet keeps the preset's name, which is the page's behaviour and is recorded as such), the Nyquist from the sample rate, the deployment order; 105 -> 109. The soil recipes' task (ADR-158) scaled Coot's mix to a quarter batch and read the tiles; Copy the list and the print were unread. The task holds the list byte for byte (author and source, one part each of peat, compost and aeration, a cup of kelp meal scaled to 4 tbsp, half cups to 2 tbsp, the flax range to 2-4 tbsp, the rock-dust range to 12 tbsp-1 cup, the cook, the warning, the footer); 40 -> 49. verify_recipes gains a PORT OF THE PAGE'S SCALING AND FORMATTING RULES as its prose states them, applied to the recipe data the page carries, and holds both the page's export and the task's literal to it; 238 -> 241. deployment-log 1 -> 3 OF 3 OUTPUTS HELD, soil-recipes 0 -> 2 OF 2, both ceilings 0; the kit's unread outputs 9 -> 5 of 66. Held: 12 tbsp-1 cup is the range rule working as stated (0.75 cup prints as tablespoons, 1 cup as a cup, so the units differ and both are shown); whether the sheet should say custom rather than the preset's name is a page question, noted and not answered here. No page was edited.
